title: Quiz: Window Functions

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in SQL?
questions.explanation: In SQL, -- marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What does RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) produce?
questions.correctAnswer: Rank of each row by salary, keeping all rows

questions.question: True or False: Window functions keep row detail while ranking.
What is the main purpose of the Window Functions technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you window functions effectively.

questions.question: In SQL, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
